principle: Match ChatGPT's surface. But every interaction signed.

features.name: Voice mode
features.scope: Audio input + output. Every utterance emits a 3KB signed card.

features.name: Vision
features.scope: Upload image. Every measurement (axis, model, score) signed.

features.name: Image generation
features.scope: DALL-E / Stable Diffusion. Every generated image signed + content-addressed.

features.name: Real-time canvas
features.scope: Side-by-side rendered markdown + code. Every edit emits a signed event card.

features.name: Shared links
features.scope: Public link to a conversation. Link is content-addressed + signed.

features.name: Group chats
features.scope: Multi-user chat room. Every user action signed.

features.name: Custom GPTs marketplace
features.scope: Hosted Custom GPTs. Every GPT signed + content-addressed.

features.name: Apps SDK
features.scope: Plug into Apps. Every plugin call signed.

features.name: Deep Research
features.scope: 8-step research pipeline. Every claim measured + signed + anchored.

features.name: Scheduled tasks
features.scope: Run any pane on schedule. Every run emits signed card.

features.name: Projects
features.scope: Workspace with files + chats + memos. Every change signed.

features.name: Side-by-side models
features.scope: Compare 2+ models on the same prompt. Every response signed.

features.name: Calendar
features.scope: Schedule + reminders. Every event signed + x402-priced.

features.name: Email
features.scope: Send / receive email. Every email signed + anchored.

features.name: SMS / phone calls
features.scope: Send SMS + place calls. Every message signed.

features.name: Document scanner
features.scope: Scan docs (PDF / image / handwritten). Every field signed.

features.name: QR code scanner
features.scope: Scan QR codes. Every code resolved + signed.
